interest_rate.label: Federal Funds Rate
interest_rate.description: US Federal Reserve target federal funds rate (annual average). Source: Federal Reserve / FRED.

inflation_cpi.label: Inflation Rate (CPI)
inflation_cpi.description: US Consumer Price Index annual % change (all urban consumers). Source: BLS / FRED.

reserve_requirement.label: Reserve Requirement (CRR)
reserve_requirement.description: US Federal Reserve reserve requirement ratio for large banks. Set to 0% in March 2020. Source: Federal Reserve.

sp500.label: S&P 500 Performance
sp500.description: S&P 500 Index year-end closing value. Source: Yahoo Finance / S&P Global.

nasdaq.label: NASDAQ Performance
nasdaq.description: NASDAQ Composite Index year-end closing value. Source: Yahoo Finance / NASDAQ.

usd_index.label: USD Strength (DXY)
usd_index.description: US Dollar Index (DXY) — measures USD against basket of 6 major currencies (year-end). Source: ICE / FRED.

gold.label: Gold Price
gold.description: Gold annual average spot price (USD per troy oz). Source: London Bullion Market / FRED.

silver.label: Silver Price
silver.description: Silver annual average spot price (USD per troy oz). Source: London Bullion Market / FRED.

oil_wti.label: Petrol (WTI Crude)
oil_wti.description: WTI crude oil annual average spot price (USD per barrel). Source: EIA / FRED.

wheat.label: Wheat Price
wheat.description: US wheat (hard red winter) annual average cash price (USD per bushel). Source: USDA / CBOT.

corn.label: Corn Price
corn.description: US corn annual average cash price (USD per bushel). Source: USDA / CBOT.

nvidia_revenue.label: NVIDIA Revenue
nvidia_revenue.description: NVIDIA Corporation annual revenue ($B) — proxy for GPU/AI semiconductor demand. Source: NVIDIA earnings reports.

micron_revenue.label: Micron Revenue
micron_revenue.description: Micron Technology annual revenue ($B) — proxy for DRAM/NAND memory market and semiconductor cycle. Source: Micron earnings reports.

cloud_revenue.label: Cloud Revenue (US Market)
cloud_revenue.description: Estimated total US cloud computing market revenue ($B). Includes AWS, Azure, GCP and others. Source: Gartner / Synergy Research estimates.

ai_investment.label: AI Adoption (US VC)
ai_investment.description: US venture capital investment in AI/ML companies ($B) — measures private-sector AI adoption rate. Source: PitchBook / Stanford AI Index.

electricity_price.label: Electricity Prices
electricity_price.description: US average residential electricity price (cents per kWh). Source: US Energy Information Administration (EIA).

fdi.label: Foreign Direct Investment
fdi.description: US FDI inflows ($B) — foreign investment into US businesses and assets. Source: BEA / UNCTAD.

household_debt.label: Household Debt
household_debt.description: US total household debt outstanding ($T), including mortgages, auto, student, and credit card debt. Source: NY Fed Consumer Credit Panel / FRED.

current_account.label: Current Account Balance
current_account.description: US current account balance ($B) — trade in goods, services, income, and transfers. Negative = deficit. Source: BEA / FRED.

trade_balance.label: Net Exports (Trade Balance)
trade_balance.description: US trade balance in goods and services ($B). Negative = trade deficit (imports > exports). Source: US Census Bureau / BEA.

weather_temp.label: US Annual Temperature
weather_temp.description: US contiguous 48-state annual average surface temperature (°F). Source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
